g.text: py-app-sign-uitrit | type sign | trim 800 x 250 mm, bleed 10 mm | status rebuilt
Bron: 21 printbestanden (source/print). Referentie = getrouwe vectorweergave; template = officiele tokenkleuren, 3 mm bleed, variabelen als live tekst. Labels staan in aparte groepen.
Bron: 15728501-1.pdf p1 (CMYK (PDF/X-4, FOGRA39), spot ThruCut; bleed box in bron ja). Template: trim 800 x 250 mm, bleed 10 mm, totaal 820 x 270 mm.
Snijcontour: groep cut-contour, spot ThruCut, 1 pt, 0.2 mm binnen de trim. source contour 799.6 x 249.6 mm, magenta 1 pt stroke on the spot ThruCut

800 x 250 mm trim, 10 mm bleed (page 820 x 270). Navy stadium with elliptical ends (rx 133.3, ry 125 mm); the template draws one navy shape into the bleed (rx 143.3, ry 135 mm, the 10 mm offset of the trim shape; the source bleed shape is 820 x 273.5 mm and sticks 1.7 mm out of the page). Cut contour: ThruCut, 1 pt magenta stroke, 0.2 mm

inside the trim, elliptical ends (the source contour is the stroke path, kept in the reference as group cut-contour). Library check: py-atom-picto-car matches the print car (same proportion, scale 6.79) and py-atom-arrow-up-circle matches the print circle and arrow (scale 1.268, arrow share 0.706). The library arc py-comp-route-module-separator has the

same shape but would print with a 5.3 mm stroke instead of 3.0 mm, so the print arc is extracted as the variant py-comp-route-module-separator-uitrit (py-atom-shape-separator-arc is the handbook illustration in grey and navy, not the aqua arc). Uit is live Ubuntu Bold 167.84 mm, white (fitted by overlay, width and height agree).
